text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a tight narrative for the latency vs price benchmark for the webinar. Hero line: 'predictable latency at lower unit cost'.
raj: Love that. Hero viz = scatter p50 (ms) on y vs $/1k tokens on x, color by deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private). Keep axes linear and log-check cost. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
tomas: Add SLA bands as step-lines (50ms, 200ms, 500ms) so folks can see fit at a glance.
emily: For headline copy we should land one conservative, measurable claim: e.g., '"Model A reduces unit cost ~3x while keeping p99 < 250ms"' but only if the data supports it.
elaine: We'll produce three quick leadlines after we see the chart: (1) eng: latency-first, (2) infra: cost-savings, (3) product: UX impact.
raj: Data ask — export per-model p50/p95/p99, avg tokens/request, batching configs, and quantization applied. I can draft the vega-lite spec once I have the CSV.
deploy-bot: export job queued: perf-exports/latency_price/1768001234.csv (ETA 10m)
oliver: I'll mock slide layout: left = hero scatter + SLA bands, right-top = tokens/request histogram + cost bars, right-bottom = batching waterfall (no-batch vs smart-batch).
tomas: For batching waterfall, show % delta for latency and $/1k between batch sizes (e.g., 1 vs 64 vs 256). Annotate with typical request length buckets.
emily: Webinar CTA idea: interactive calculator (model + batch size -> est $/1k + p50/p95). Funnel: SMB -> free trial; Enterprise -> book a Dedicated consult. @growth to wire routing.
elaine: Responsibilities: Raj = raw charts + minimal fig spec; Oliver = slide mock + placeholder visuals; Emily = copy + CTA content; Tomas = batching micro-visual rules. I'll own final narrative.
raj: Vega-lite skeleton for designers to wireframe quickly:
```
{ "mark": "point", "encoding": { "x": {"field": "cost_per_1k","type":"quantitative"}, "y": {"field":"p50_ms","type":"quantitative"}, "color": {"field":"deployment_mode","type":"nominal"} } }
```
oliver: Mockup ETA = tomorrow EOD with placeholders.
emily: Draft headline options:
- Serve fast, pay less: predictable low-latency inference at lower unit cost
- Cut token spend without sacrificing response time
- Price-performance that scales: latency SLAs, unit economics
We'll pick one after seeing the chart.
tomas: One more: include a visible one-line methodology footnote (sample sizes, sequence length quantiles, quantization level). Don't hide it.
raj: Downloaded export: perf-exports/latency_price/1768001234.csv (link posted). Pushing first chart in +3h.
deploy-bot: perf-exports/latency_price/1768001234.csv ready (https://files.redwood.test/perf-exports/latency_price/1768001234.csv)
elaine: Great work. Post chart and 1-sentence leadlines here for a quick review before design handoff. :rocket:
